results.note: Third-party guides say entry is free, but the Visit Lisboa tourism page I opened (https://www.visitlisboa.com/en/places/feira-da-ladra-flea-market) gives hours and history and doesn't mention admission. No official or government page I could read states the price.

Time Out Lisbon and WhichMuseum list a €3 standard ticket (reduced €1.50), but neither is an official, ticketing or government page. The official Museu de Lisboa pages loaded without any price text, and Visit Lisboa only links to the museum's admission page. So I couldn't verify €3 on an acceptable source.
No page I found states an admission price. Time Out describes it as an events venue, and visits seem to be booked by prior arrangement.

Gulbenkian Música is a concert series, not a single admission. Prices vary by concert, and some concerts are free. The Gulbenkian pages I tried were blocked (403) or showed no prices, so no standard adult price is stated.
